_schema.fitment: Mitas sizes that fit the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 (90/90-21 front, 140/80-17 rear), from the Mitas Moto catalogue 2026. Dimensions are E.T.R.T.O. figures in mm: the design section width and overall diameter, then the maximum in service; rim widths in inches, measuring rim and permitted range.

tyres.model: Terra Force-R (being rebranded Enduro Trail-SP, size by size)
tyres.note: Classified for 90 % on-road use; multi-compound tread (catalogue p. 30). The catalogue does not explain the asterisk after TL.
Classified for 70 % on-road use (catalogue p. 32). No 140/80-17 rear: the rears are 150/70R17, 170/60ZR17 and 150/70R18, so there is no 70/30 Mitas pair for the Himalayan 450.

tyres.construction: bias-belted (B) rear; approved TL and TT

variants.dakar: yellow stripe — stiffer carcass/sidewall, longer-wearing compound

tyres.profile_note: more rounded profile than the E-07 (50/50); independent shoulder knobs
tyres.mixing: can be mixed with other E-07/E-07+ or Enduro Trail 60/40 and 50/50 tyres

himalayan_450_fitment.dakar: front 90/90B21 54H only; the catalogue lists no Dakar 140/80B17 rear

tyres.note: Classified M+S for 60 % on-road use (catalogue pp. 34–35).
Classified M+S for 50 % on-road use (catalogue pp. 36–37).
Classified M+S for 20 % on-road use, for rally configurations (catalogue pp. 40–41); the 140/80B17 rear exists only in the Dakar version.
Reported as fitted to UK/EU Himalayans by a London tyre shop.

class_tradeoffs.road_biased: smoother tread, narrower sipes and larger contact patches: better cornering stability, braking, wet grip and life on asphalt; copes with maintained dirt roads and light gravel
class_tradeoffs.knobbly: larger, more open blocks bite into loose terrain (sand, mud, loose rock); on pavement more noise and vibration, less cornering confidence and faster wear
class_tradeoffs.measured_grip: No manufacturer publishes grip curves for these tyres, and no measured motorcycle wet-braking comparison between tyre classes was found; the simulator therefore uses one tyre curve for all of them.

size_code.example: 120/90 → 120/80 lowers sidewall 108 → 96 mm, axle drops 12 mm
